test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Sundaram Balachander has been the main player of which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Veena.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sundaram Balachander** was an Indian veena player and filmmaker
 
• Balachander was honoured with the **Padma Bhushan in 1982**.
 
• In 1948 he directed the film En Kanavar. In 1954 he directed Andha Naal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7554010421b1ba39d7ba86651005d26af5ade23c3a4311f3cf2683072d1cd229.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
